reason: The only proposal (D-4e8196) is about redirects in utils and says nothing on docstrings; structured docstrings mostly use Args:/Returns: (29 files) but Sphinx-style :param appears in 8 files.
No proposal covers docstring arg types; only about 35 of 77 Args sections start with a typed `name (type):` entry, and many (utils/search, utils/mail) omit types.
No proposal covers docstring punctuation; many docstring summaries and arg entries lack a final period (e.g. SearchEngineBase methods in utils/search/__init__.py).

No proposal about template tag signatures; about half of the tags with defaults use `*` (bw_user_avatar, bw_tag), while display_sound, display_pack, display_user, bw_icon, sounds_selector and others take positional optional args.
No proposal covers template tag calls; most optional args are passed by keyword (size=, anchor=, selected=), but bw_icon's class_name is passed positionally in about 30 template usages.
No proposal about permissions; all four custom permissions are declared in Meta.permissions of related models (Ticket, Post, BulkUploadProgress, Profile).
No proposal about groups; all four custom permissions appear in groups in user_groups.json.
No proposal about parameter_user; request.parameter_user is read only inside utils/username.py, and views use get_parameter_user_or_404.
No proposal about username decorators; most public username views use it, but sounds/views.py pack_licenses, attribution_modal, downloaders, pack_downloaders and ratings rate_sound do not.
No proposal covers this; no @login_required view also has @redirect_if_old_username (sound_edit and follow_user use login_required alone).
No proposal covers this; raise_404_if_user_is_deleted is used on many user-listing views, but which views must be unreachable depends on intent, which the code alone cannot show.
No proposal covers decorator order; in every view that uses both, redirect_if_old_username is directly above raise_404_if_user_is_deleted.
No proposal about migrations; 28 of 208 migrations contain RunPython/RunSQL, several with sizeable data-copy loops (e.g. geotags 0008).
No proposal about migrations; AddField on Sound/Profile/Download adds about 12 non-null columns with defaults against 7 nullable ones (e.g. Profile booleans with default in accounts 0038).
No proposal covers this; delete_user clears about, home_page, signature, geotag and avatar but not sound_signature, a personal free-text field.
No proposal covers this; on_delete_sound copies all Sound fields through .values() and converts every Sound date/datetime field (created, moderation_date, processing_date, date_recorded).
No proposal about JS modals; handleGenericModal* is used in 11 files, but manageSounds.js and loginModals.js call activateModal directly with custom logic.
No proposal covers search options; every option is declared in SearchQueryProcessor.option_definitions with a SearchOption* subclass and turned into an instance.
No proposal covers this; query_params derivation is centralized in SearchQueryProcessor.as_query_params.
No proposal covers templates; search.html uses display_search_option 15 times, but some options (search_in, duration) are rendered by hand.
No proposal about backends; Solr555PySolrSearchEngine subclasses SearchEngineBase and Solr9PySolrSearchEngine extends it.
No proposal about metrics; every counted metric is a prometheus_client.Counter incremented with .inc().
No proposal covers this; each metric is defined in the module that uses it, and the shared request-limit counter sits in utils/ratelimit.py behind a helper.
No proposal about builtins; ruff A runs in CI, but A001/A002 are ignored and arguments shadow builtins (input, id, type, object) in several places.
No proposal covers bugbear; ruff check with B selected runs in CI and pre-commit (some B codes ignored). Not run here.
